AI quality / Cost and escalation

Cost per validated AI task

The cohort-scoped cost of models, tools, infrastructure, and human review divided by validated successful outcomes from the same cohort. Costs include failed attempts and retries incurred to produce those outcomes.

Explore in the metric hierarchy ↗Open calculators →
Level 4Inspect the detail

The cohort-scoped cost of models, tools, infrastructure, and human review divided by validated successful outcomes from the same cohort. Costs include failed attempts and retries incurred to produce those outcomes.

currency/task

How we use it

We compare workflows using validated business outcomes and identify where retries, tool calls, or review effort add avoidable cost.

Transparent calculation(Model cost + tool cost + infrastructure cost + human review cost for the task cohort) / validated successful tasks from that cohort
model cost120
tool cost40
infrastructure cost20
human review cost100
validated successful tasks700

(120 + 40 + 20 + 100) / 700 = 0.40 currency units per validated task.

Illustrative calculation. Not a client result or a universal benchmark.

Break the result down

  • Task type and cohort
  • Model and tool configuration
  • Retries and human review effort

Questions we investigate

  • Which retries or tool steps dominate cost?
  • Are all failed attempts included?
  • Does a cheaper configuration preserve acceptance quality?

Actions the evidence supports

  • Reconcile usage costs to task identifiers.
  • Test simpler configurations against acceptance criteria.
  • Review cost with quality and completion outcomes.

Reporting contract

Ownership & cadence

AI operations and finance leads
Weekly during optimization; monthly for closed cost cohorts.

Required data

  • Cohort-linked model, tool, and infrastructure costs
  • Human review time and costing policy
  • Validated successful task counts

Read the measure with context

Zero validated successes makes cost per task undefined. Define allocation and shared-cost treatment consistently. These illustrative costs are not provider price quotes. Lower cost is useful only alongside quality, completion, latency, and escalation requirements.
